findings.title: Exit-code contract changed for recreate upgrade and reused for feature disabled
findings.body: RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE is changed from 4 to 3, and the new FEATURE_DISABLED code uses 4. The update-compatibility command is documented as scriptable and its exit codes are part of its contract, so existing automation written against the previous code may now interpret a recreate-required result as feature-disabled. If this breaking change is intentional, it should be explicitly called out; otherwise consider preserving the old code and using a new value.

findings.title: Feature-disabled behavior is not fully tested
findings.body: testFeatureNotEnabled only exercises the metadata subcommand and only asserts the error message. It does not assert the new exit code 4, and it does not cover the identical feature-disabled branch added to UpdateCompatibilityCheck. Adding assertions for the exit code and for both metadata and check subcommands would protect the documented exit-code contract.
